limits: All five jobs completed successfully in the first attempt (no rerun); this artifact audit certifies only the eight headless capture-notification lanes (672 checks).
The two retained sabotages remain local evidence; the committed report records that no preceding-host control applies (no native or SDK change).
Bundle hashes and the native host hash are declared by the runner; no bundle or native binary is included in the artifact.
CI host hash is not required to equal the local built host.
Mobile and parity jobs are separate: only their PASSED markers are recorded, their outputs are not audited here.
Git-tree verification establishes tracked content at the pushed main checkout; it does not independently inspect a compiled native binary.
The slice's own committed limits are unchanged and still apply:
Mouse left button and touches over two roots of one application, eight original/current x flag lanes on one host, headless.

Hover offsets follow the host's per-target projection (pointer geometry) and are not certified here; capture under transforms, pen, multiple windows, hardware and Godot mobile exports are not exercised.

Removing a capture target clears it without lostpointercapture (RN 0.87.1 has no path to the Document and crashes when a retained owner is removed); W3C's lostpointercapture at the document is not adopted.

A contact whose hit view or origin is removed is canceled by the host's earlier lifetime rule; listeners see neither pointercancel nor lostpointercapture, and the held mouse button stays inert until released.
Imperative hover listeners while captured, capture by a view of another root, wrong-owner release and stopPropagation/once/AbortSignal on capture listeners are not separately exercised.
No whole GF, checkpoint, dependency, weight or denominator closed.
